verses.text: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
lines: The plans of the heart belong to man,
but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

verses.text: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives.
lines: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes;
but Yahweh weighs the motives.

verses.text: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
lines: Commit your deeds to Yahweh,
and your plans shall succeed.

verses.text: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
lines: Yahweh has made everything for its own end—
yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

verses.text: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.
lines: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh:
they shall certainly not be unpunished.

verses.text: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
lines: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for.
By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.

verses.text: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
lines: When a man’s ways please Yahweh,
he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

verses.text: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
lines: Better is a little with righteousness,
than great revenues with injustice.

verses.text: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
lines: A man’s heart plans his course,
but Yahweh directs his steps.

verses.text: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
lines: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king.
He shall not betray his mouth.

verses.text: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
lines: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s;
all the weights in the bag are his work.

verses.text: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
lines: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong,
for the throne is established by righteousness.

verses.text: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
lines: Righteous lips are the delight of kings.
They value one who speaks the truth.

verses.text: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
lines: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death,
but a wise man will pacify it.

verses.text: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
lines: In the light of the king’s face is life.
His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

verses.text: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
lines: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold!
Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

verses.text: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
lines: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil.
He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

verses.text: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
lines: Pride goes before destruction,
and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

verses.text: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
lines: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor,
than to divide the plunder with the proud.

verses.text: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
lines: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity.
Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.

verses.text: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
lines: The wise in heart shall be called prudent.
Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

verses.text: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
lines: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it,
but the punishment of fools is their folly.

verses.text: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
lines: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth,
and adds learning to his lips.

verses.text: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
lines: Pleasant words are a honeycomb,
sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

verses.text: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
lines: There is a way which seems right to a man,
but in the end it leads to death.

verses.text: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.
lines: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him;
for his mouth urges him on.

verses.text: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
lines: A worthless man devises mischief.
His speech is like a scorching fire.

verses.text: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
lines: A perverse man stirs up strife.
A whisperer separates close friends.

verses.text: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
lines: A man of violence entices his neighbor,
and leads him in a way that is not good.

verses.text: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
lines: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities,
one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

verses.text: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
lines: Gray hair is a crown of glory.
It is attained by a life of righteousness.

verses.text: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
lines: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty;
one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

verses.text: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
lines: The lot is cast into the lap,
but its every decision is from Yahweh.
